critical_code_review_comments: AtlasPicker uses tailwind classes grid-cols-16/grid-rows-16 which are not in Tailwind's default scale — may render as 1-col fallback unless tailwind.config extends grid. Functionally slots are clickable via data-testid, but visual grid may collapse. Consider extending tailwind.config or using inline style gridTemplateColumns/Rows: repeat(16, minmax(0, 1fr)).
server.py build_gltf_files replaces literal 'gltf_buffer.bin' string in the JSON — brittle to future trimesh version changes; parse JSON and rewrite buffers[0].uri instead for robustness.

Recipe error toast fires correctly, but rowsFromGrid() trims outer blank rows/cols which could cause surprising outputs vs the raw grid; consider showing the effective rows preview beside the live grid preview.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ prefixed snippet and export payloads; snippet deleted at end of test; no residual data. During Playwright run 2 snippets left in DB from creature-save flow (Snippet library kept 2 items after delete).
